verdict.rationale: Apify is a SaaS data platform, so a privacy control that keeps user data out of AI model training is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers a training opt-out, data-use policy, or privacy setting. The items cover Actors, scheduling, proxies, webhooks, MCP and CLI, none of which relate to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
